ResearchProjectDef.label: Healing Hypertech
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlocks the crafting of Bacta Spray and Kolto Gel Packs, simple but effective medical items. Also unlocks the construction of bacta creation and processing systems for the filling of bacta tanks, allowing hyper accelerated healing to occur, even healing otherwise permanent scars.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Cybernetics
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlocks the crafting cybernetic body parts, replacements for their organic counterparts which can perform as well as the original organic parts.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Enhanced Cybernetics
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlocks the crafting enhanced cybernetic body parts, upgraded and more specialised versions of the cybernetic options.
